writings.description: Pieces the author wrote themselves, pasted. 3-20 recommended. Writing read by earlier steps counts too.

admired_authors.description: Writers whose style the author likes, optionally with what they like about it. Direction words only.

avoid.description: What the author never wants to sound like.

platforms.description: Platforms that get a note. Absent: linkedin and x.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
